{{Quote|No problems until we got to the magnogravitics plant. The Wookiees in the plant refused to hand it over&mdash;they ambushed us, and now they're holding the factory. It's a bitter pill.|Helricks|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''magnogravitics plant''' was located in the [[Labor Valley]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the plant's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers rose up against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] invaders there.
